breakdown.method: Batch score = lowest page score (07-judge.md; config pass_threshold 90); the batch has one page, /ur/plan/, whose score is its lowest key (plan.routeLimit, plan.empty.d, plan.shared.h = 91). Each key scored on five axes: accuracy 30, nativeness 30, termbase/transliteration/orthography 20, fit for the Urdu-speaking traveller 10, structure 10. The axes below are the page minimums and sum to 91. The blind reader's 62/100 is a reading, not the score: its deductions are mostly charged to published wording and rulings that bind (see blind_reader_rulings), to source or template design (source_defects), and to tool artefacts.

accuracy.note: plan.empty.d -1: the source's two verbs (click, tap) are one neutral verb «چنیں» (N730, owner decision 2026-10-21, cost already charged by N332). plan.location -1: «نقشے پر» is not in either source but names the link's real target (N731). plan.routeLimit/plan.empty.h: «زیادہ سے زیادہ» and «ابھی» are entailed or carried by the Arabic, no deduction. No fact, number or name added; both 10s Latin.

nativeness.note: plan.shared.h -2: «اشتراک کردہ» is stiff (reader items 8, 11); kept under N733 because the fallback «کی اشتراک کی گئی» stacks «کی … کی» and the loan «شیئر» is refused (P16-test). plan.routeLimit -2: «کھلنے والے راستے میں … شامل ہوں گے» is heavy and «پڑاؤ» can read as a camp (N734 binds). plan.empty.d -1: «چنیں» for acting on a button is the line's neutral verb, not the everyday phone word. Published phrases «اس آلے پر», «بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں», «محفوظ کردہ» are chatty or official but bind by sibling consistency.

termbase_style.note: plan.shared.h -1: «اشتراک کردہ» participle of the N3 verb, no termbase entry of its own. «پڑاؤ» is still status pending (no dictionary page read in the line). Letterforms, digits, punctuation, quotes, P22 pronouns, P2 head name, brands and P16-admitted loans all clean (stage 5 list and verify.mjs OK).

fit_for_traveller.note: -1: the shared-list box (paragraph plus «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات دیکھیں») can be misread as viewing the shared list; that is the source's design (SD-M2) and the Urdu keeps faith. Labels are short, the counter reads as a count line, the confirm is one question ending in «؟».

structure.note: 26 keys in pack order; no placeholder, markup or link in any string; Latin 10 twice in plan.routeLimit and nothing else; the arrow follows one space; plan.title equals ui.nav.myTrip and plan.empty.browse equals the published sibling byte for byte.

strings.plan.title: میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات
strings.plan.lead: آپ نے جو سیاحتی مقامات چنے ہیں، وہ اس آلے پر محفوظ ہیں۔ انہیں ترتیب دیں اور بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں۔
strings.plan.clearConfirm: کیا آپ اپنے محفوظ کردہ مقامات کی پوری فہرست خالی کرنا چاہتے ہیں؟
strings.plan.routeLimit: گوگل میپس ایک راستے میں زیادہ سے زیادہ 10 پڑاؤ قبول کرتا ہے، اس لیے کھلنے والے راستے میں آپ کی فہرست کے پہلے 10 سیاحتی مقامات شامل ہوں گے۔
strings.plan.empty.h: آپ کی فہرست ابھی خالی ہے
strings.plan.empty.d: سیاحتی مقامات دیکھیں، اور انہیں یہاں جمع کرنے کے لیے “یہ مقام محفوظ کریں” چنیں۔ پھر بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں۔
strings.plan.waText: الاحساء میں میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات:
strings.plan.shared.h: سیاحتی مقامات کی اشتراک کردہ فہرست
strings.plan.shared.d: یہ فہرست آپ کو اشتراک کے لنک سے ملی ہے۔ اسے دیکھیں، یا اپنے “میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات” میں شامل کر لیں۔
strings.plan.shared.import: میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات میں شامل کریں
strings.plan.printNote: اوقات اور فیس میں تبدیلی ہو سکتی ہے، اس لیے جانے سے پہلے سرکاری ذرائع سے تصدیق کر لیں۔

notes: [s1] plan.title: H1 is byte-for-byte the published ui.nav.myTrip / tm plan-your-trip ctaTrip «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات». The page, the nav link and the H1 are one name; no difference to justify.

[s1] Landmark noun: counter and routeLimit use the published «سیاحتی مقامات» (plural, ui.nav.attractions) and «سیاحتی مقام» (singular, column head); title/clearConfirm/shared strings use «مقامات» alone because that is the published form inside «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات». No third synonym («مقام کی جگہ», «نشان», «سیر گاہ») is introduced.

[s1] plan.savedSuffix / plan.savedOne: the script writes the number first, so the label is «<n> سیاحتی مقامات محفوظ» (n != 1) and «1 سیاحتی مقام محفوظ». No stop. plan.savedTwo and plan.savedFew are never rendered in Urdu (Intl.PluralRules gives one/other only); written correctly anyway, identical to savedSuffix (zh/de/ru precedent keeps them parallel).

[s1] plan.empty.d (PROVISIONAL, owner decision 2026-10-21 device-neutral verb): the button is quoted verbatim as the published ui.fav.add «یہ مقام محفوظ کریں». The click-or-tap verb is «چنیں», the device-neutral everyday verb of N332 (E); «کلک» and «ٹیپ» are refused by P16/N332/N720, «دبائیں» by N89/N727, «چھو کر» is touch-only (N720). «کھول کر» (N720) does not fit because the button is not opened. Cost: the source's two verbs become one neutral verb. A blind reader may suggest «دبائیں»; hold the line on N332/N727.

[s1] Route noun (PROVISIONAL): «راستہ» in plan.lead, plan.route, plan.routeLimit, plan.empty.d. This page's route is the Google Maps directions through the saved stops, the sense of the published tm plan-your-trip ctaD «گوگل میپس پر بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں» and visa-guide «سفر کا بنا بنایا راستہ». N612 reserves «سفری منصوبہ» for the home planner itinerary and N336 moved the visa routes to «طریقہ»; neither applies here (directions are exactly «راستہ»). The stops are «پڑاؤ» (termbase entry, ar محطة).
[s1] plan.route: «گوگل میپس پر راستہ کھولیں», preposition «پر» as in published det.openMaps «گوگل میپس پر دیکھیں ↗». Brand is the termbase «گوگل میپس».

[s1] plan.share: «واٹس ایپ پر اشتراک کریں». «واٹس ایپ» is the termbase entry (verified, ui foot.l.whatsapp) and «اشتراک کریں» is the published share.btn (N3). plan.copy: «اشتراک کا لنک کاپی کریں»; «لنک» and «کاپی» are P16-admitted, and the published plan.copied is «لنک کاپی ہو گیا ✓», so button and result share the verb.

[s1] plan.print (PROVISIONAL): «فہرست چھاپیں». «پرنٹ» is not on the admitted-loan list (P16/P16-test) and I found no ruling admitting it; «چھاپنا» is the common native verb. If a blind reader or the owner shows Urdu browser UIs name the function «پرنٹ», P16-test (1) would be met and the label could become «فہرست پرنٹ کریں». Not verified against a localized interface.

[s1] plan.clear / plan.clearConfirm: button «فہرست خالی کریں» (ar أفرغ = empty), confirm question uses the same verb «خالی کرنا» and ends «؟». «تمام» is in the source («all your saved places»), so N620's no-unsourced-quantifier ban is not engaged. plan.remove «ہٹائیں» (published «ریت ہٹائیں» shows the verb; no ruling on the button).

[s1] plan.location (PROVISIONAL): «جگہ ↗» for «Location ↗» (a card link to the place in Google Maps). Reason: «مقام» alone would collide with «سیاحتی مقام» / «یہ مقام محفوظ کریں» where it means the place itself; published «نقشے پر میری جگہ» (map.locate) uses «جگہ» for location. Alternative if a reader finds it too bare: «نقشے پر جگہ ↗» (adds «on the map», which is true of the link target).

[s1] plan.waText: «الاحساء میں میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات:» keeps the source's trailing colon (ASCII, as in published home saved.count «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات:»), since the link follows on a new line. Head name «الاحساء» per P2.

[s1] plan.shared.h (PROVISIONAL): «سیاحتی مقامات کی اشتراک کردہ فہرست»; «اشتراک کردہ» derives from the published «اشتراک کریں». Alternative reading «آپ کے ساتھ شیئر کی گئی فہرست» refused (loan «شیئر»). No stop at the end of the heading.

[s1] plan.shared.d: the em dash becomes a sentence break. Own list is named with the published «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات» in “ ” as the English and Arabic quote it; «اپنے» carries the Arabic «عندك» / English «your own».
[s1] plan.shared.import / plan.shared.mine: buttons keep the first-person «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات» of the title so the button, the page and the H1 name the same thing (pack trap 1).

[s1] plan.printNote: dash becomes «، اس لیے»; «سرکاری ذرائع» is the published events.srcNote wording for official channels and «جانے سے پہلے … تصدیق کر لیں» the published det.hoursNotice/evd.notice frame. No unsourced addition.
[s1] plan.lead: «اس آلے پر» (published «آپ کے آلے کی تاریخ», ui events.orderNote); the loan «ڈیوائس» is not admitted (P16). Meta-description sentence: two short sentences, no stop dropped.

[s1] plan.routeLimit: «زیادہ سے زیادہ» is the sense of the source's «accepts 10 stops per route» used as a limit (ctx says limit; ru «не более», zh «最多»); the figure 10 stays Latin and appears twice as in the source. No other number.
[s1] plan.empty.h: «ابھی» follows the Arabic «بعد» and the zh/de/ru precedents («还是», «noch», «пока»); the English has no «yet». Meaning-neutral, recorded as a divergence.

[s1] plan.empty.browse is the published sibling «سیاحتی مقامات دیکھیں» verbatim (ref.siblings, tm ui/events.ctaBrowse). plan.empty.map «نقشہ کھولیں» uses the published nav.map «نقشہ»; the target page title is «سیاحتی مقامات کا نقشہ».

[s1] SOURCE OBSERVATION: the English savedSuffix «sights saved» and the ctx example «{n} saved places» differ in noun, and the page title says «places» while the counter says «sights»; Urdu follows the English noun per string and keeps the published pair «سیاحتی مقامات» (names) and «مقامات» (title). Not a defect that blocks translation.

[s2] plan.print SETTLED: «فہرست چھاپیں» stands. P16-test (1) is not met: the Urdu Wikipedia interface itself names the function with native words (MediaWiki messages print «طباعت», printableversion «قابل طبع نسخہ»; fetched from ur.wikipedia api allmessages, HTTP 200), and «چھاپنا» is the common verb; no ruling admits «پرنٹ». S1's open point is closed; the loan is not entered. Not verified against Chrome/Android Urdu strings.

[s2] plan.location SETTLED: «جگہ ↗» alone is a bare noun that does not tell a card reader where the arrow leads («جگہ» could be the card's own place); the published det.openMaps «گوگل میپس پر دیکھیں ↗» and map.locate «نقشے پر میری جگہ» both anchor the word to the map. Taken s1's own alternative: «نقشے پر جگہ ↗». «مقام» still avoided (collision with «یہ مقام محفوظ کریں»), no «لوکیشن» (P16). The arrow stays after one space as in det.openMaps / tm «نقشہ ↗».

[s2] plan.empty.d: the purpose clause that stranded the verb behind a long object chain is split: «دیکھیں، اور انہیں یہاں جمع کرنے کے لیے … چنیں» then «پھر … مل جائے گا». The button stays quoted verbatim “یہ مقام محفوظ کریں”; the verb stays «چنیں» (N332 E, device-neutral, owner decision 2026-10-21). «اپنی منزلیں» (s1) dropped for «انہیں»: «منزل» is also a floor of a building and its published use «مقامات اور منزلیں» (fact.sites.l) is on the open published-ur-labels-flagged list (three readers); the sights are already «سیاحتی مقامات» in the same sentence, so no third noun is needed. «آپ کو اس کے بعد» became «پھر» (shorter).

[s2] plan.clearConfirm: «تمام محفوظ کردہ مقامات کی فہرست» was a scope slip (all of the places' list); the Arabic quantifier «كاملةً» belongs to the list, so «محفوظ کردہ مقامات کی پوری فہرست». N620 not engaged (no quantifier added). Verb «خالی کرنا» unchanged, same as the button plan.clear.

[s2] plan.routeLimit: «راستہ آپ کی فہرست کے پہلے 10 سیاحتی مقامات کے ساتھ کھلے گا» was a calque of 'opens with'; finite Urdu: «کھلنے والے راستے میں … پہلے 10 سیاحتی مقامات شامل ہوں گے». Both 10s stay Latin; no new number or claim (the source says only that the route opens with the first 10). «پڑاؤ» for stops kept (home.route.lead precedent; N526 restricts it from running-text birds' rests, not from route stops).

[s2] plan.shared.d: «کے ذریعے پہنچی ہے» (dftari) became «ملی ہے» with «سے»: «یہ فہرست آپ کو اشتراک کے لنک سے ملی ہے». Sense unchanged (the list reached you via a share link). plan.lead: comma before «اور» removed (two imperatives joined, no pause needed); wording otherwise s1's.

[s2] Unchanged on purpose: plan.shared.h «اشتراک کردہ» (a little formal, but it is the participle of the published N3 verb, and the loan «شیئر» is refused by P16-test); plan.copy / plan.share / plan.route / plan.clear / plan.remove (short labels, no officialese); counter pair (a fragment label reads as a count line after the numeral, no «ہیں» so it is not a sentence, per BRIEF trap 2); title and eyebrow; the two published siblings.

[s3] Localizer pass: nothing in this page is geography, heritage or Saudi-institution vocabulary that needs a gloss, and the strings are labels, so no gloss, no season/heat/hours framing and no etiquette is added (the fence). The only audience-specific choice is the device-neutral verb and the Urdu-reader's WhatsApp spelling «واٹس ایپ» (termbase), both ruled earlier. plan.waText stays a neutral line a Urdu-speaking resident would send before a link, head name «الاحساء» (P2), colon kept as in published home saved.count.
[s3] plan.printNote: «سرکاری ذرائع» kept; the strings add no hours, fees or place names, so there is no figure to localize. Verified against the unchanged published det.hoursNotice frame.

[s4] Siblings checked byte for byte against ref.json: plan.title = ui.nav.myTrip = tm plan-your-trip/ctaTrip «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات» (equal); plan.empty.browse = tm ui/events.ctaBrowse = tm plan-your-trip/ctaBrowse «سیاحتی مقامات دیکھیں» (equal). Also equal to the published forms: the quoted button “یہ مقام محفوظ کریں” (ui.fav.add), «گوگل میپس», «واٹس ایپ», «الاحساء», «سرکاری ذرائع» (events.srcNote), and the det.hoursNotice frame «اوقات اور فیس میں تبدیلی ہو سکتی ہے، اس لیے جانے سے پہلے … سے تصدیق کر لیں۔». The title name repeated inside plan.shared.d (in “ ”), plan.shared.import, plan.shared.mine and plan.waText (the last as the longer «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات:») is byte-identical to plan.title.

[s4] Fact fence: nothing of s2/s3 deleted, because nothing they added carries a fact the sources lack. Audited: «پوری» (clearConfirm) is the Arabic «كاملةً»; «ابھی» (empty.h) is the Arabic «بعد»; «نقشے پر» (location) is not in en or ar but is the nature of the link, which the template builds from the place's mapUrl (PlanView.astro, class pc-map, target google maps), so it names the destination and states nothing about the place (see N731); «زیادہ سے زیادہ» (routeLimit, from s1) is the limit that 'accepts 10 stops per route … so the first 10' entails and the ctx names, not a P19 evaluative superlative. One MOOD change, not a fact: s2's future promise «مل جائے گا» in empty.d became the imperative of the sources and of plan.lead.

[s4] plan.empty.d: s2's second sentence «پھر بنا بنایا راستہ آپ کو مل جائے گا۔» promised an outcome where en («then get a ready route») and ar («ثم احصل على مسارٍ جاهز») instruct; and the same page's plan.lead says «بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں» (as does the published ctaD). Back to the imperative with the lead's verb: «پھر بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں۔». Published visa-guide uses «مل جائے گا» for its own English; that pair is left alone.

[s4] Calque/translation-smell sweep: no «موجود ہے/پایا جاتا ہے», no stacked «ہوئے» (one «چنے ہوئے» in plan.lead, the everyday participle, kept), no English article rendered as «یہ/وہ/ایک» (the only «یہ» are in the quoted published button and in plan.shared.d where en has «This list»), no «کیا جاتا ہے» passive. «قبول کرتا ہے» (software accepts input) kept. Nothing else rewritten.

[s4] Names: all in the termbase/published list (الاحساء, گوگل میپس, واٹس ایپ; the 'places' list of ref.json is empty). No new term, no addition. «پڑاؤ» is still status pending in the termbase (gender «مذکر» from the entry; not re-verified at s4: rekhtadictionary answered HTTP 503, ur.wikipedia 429 on the later calls; no count is quoted from a non-200). Gulf/exonym/letterform spot-check: none of the Gulf names occurs; no ي ك ة ه ى أ إ in the strings.

[s4] N730 (the visitor's action on a quoted action button, plan.empty.d): the verb is «چنیں» after the label quoted verbatim: «… جمع کرنے کے لیے “یہ مقام محفوظ کریں” چنیں۔». N332 (E) decided this verb as the device-neutral one for acting on a place or an option and owner decision 2026-10-21 asks for a verb that fits tap and click; the sources' «click or tap» / «اضغط» are one action. Not «کلک / ٹیپ» (P16, N332), not «دبائیں» (N89, N727), not «چھو کر» (N720), not «کھول کر» (the button saves; it opens nothing, so the N89 frame «… کا لنک کھولیں» is not used) and no noun «بٹن» is added (N89). Binds only the verb of plan.empty.d.

[s4] N731 (the card link «Location ↗», plan.location): «نقشے پر جگہ ↗». The noun is «جگہ» (published ui events.placeK «Location» → «جگہ»; map.locate «نقشے پر میری جگہ»), anchored to the map as the arrow links of the line are (det.openMaps «گوگل میپس پر دیکھیں ↗», events.mapK «نقشہ ↗»); not «مقام» (the attraction itself, N4), not «لوکیشن» (P16). Decides the arrow link of the plan card only: the plain field label «Location» is not touched (events.placeK «جگہ», stay dv.areaH «مقام» stand as published).

[s4] N732 (the print function, plan.print): the label is «فہرست چھاپیں». P16-test (1) is not met on the evidence of record (s2: the Urdu Wikipedia interface names printing with native words «طباعت» / «قابل طبع نسخہ», HTTP 200; not re-fetched at s4, the later request got 429): the native verb «چھاپنا» is the common one and «پرنٹ» is not admitted. Provisional on one point: it is not checked against the Chrome/Android Urdu interface; if that shows «پرنٹ» as the name of the function and a blind reader stumbles, P16-test could be reopened for this one label. Binds the label of plan.print only.

[s4] N733 (the shared list, plan.shared.h): «سیاحتی مقامات کی اشتراک کردہ فہرست». «اشتراک کردہ» is the participle of the verb of N3 («اشتراک کریں») and pairs with the page's own «محفوظ کردہ» (nav.myTrip); the loan «شیئر» stays refused (P16-test). Cost: a little formal. ur.wikipedia returned 6 results for the exact phrase «اشتراک کردہ» (HTTP 200, one query; a name-form count only, not a style test). Binds this heading only; the alternative «اشتراک کی گئی فہرست» is the fallback if a blind reader stumbles.

[s4] N734 (the route noun on /ur/plan/): «راستہ» names the Google Maps route through the saved stops in plan.lead, plan.route, plan.routeLimit and plan.empty.d, and its stops are «پڑاؤ». N612 (the planner's itinerary is «سفری منصوبہ», because a reader took «راستہ» as road directions on the home planner) is not engaged: here directions are what the page produces, the very sense of the published ctaD «گوگل میپس پر بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں». N526 reserves «پڑاؤ» for running text of trail pages and binds trail strings; the stops of a route keep the home.route.lead use. Binds the four strings above, not other pages.

[s5] Item 1 (letterforms): regex [يكةهىأإۃ] over all 26 strings: 0 hits (none). Over the whole ur-04 file: 16 hits, all inside the English-language notes that quote Arabic source words by design (U+0629, U+0623, U+0643, U+0649, U+0647) or list the forbidden letters in the s4 spot-check note; none in a string. source_defects.defect: The English 'Arrange them' and the Arabic «رتّبها» promise arranging, but the page has no control that sorts or reorders (PlanView.astro: cards render in saved order; no sort, drag or reorder code). The 'first 10 sights on your list' of plan.routeLimit therefore depends on an order the visitor cannot set, and 'ready-made route' promises more than the plain Google Maps directions link delivers (reader #4, #5, #13). The Urdu keeps faith; the owner can drop 'Arrange them' from the three languages or add the control.

Shared-list mode (?list=): the box invites the visitor to 'browse it', but its only view button is 'View my saved places', which in the template (mine-btn) drops ?list= and returns to the visitor's own list; the H1 and the counter keep 'My saved places' / 'saved' while the cards are someone else's; what 'Add' does (merges the shared stops into the visitor's list, import-btn) is not said (reader #9, serious). Source and template design; the Urdu keeps faith.

PlanView.astro (tree fe0bab0 with local edits, as read at stage 7): browseHref has a ur branch (/ur/attractions/) but mapHref has none, so in the tree read the empty-state map button of the Urdu page falls through to /en/map/ instead of /ur/map/ (BRIEF names /ur/map/). Template fix, outside the translation line; check before the page ships.

The lead is passed as the page's meta description (Base description = t('plan.lead')) and also rendered under the H1, so a description and the visible lead are the same sentences (reader #7). Template design; a separate plan.desc string would be needed to differ.

Tab title = plan.title + titleSep + site.brand: the brand line stays the Latin wordmark and the separator is the template's (reader #1). This is the open item BRAND (N1), the owner's to decide; the reader also asks that the tab title say the list is the visitor's own, which the single string plan.title cannot do.

No user-facing message exists for: a failed clipboard write (the script swallows the error and shows nothing), a failed share or Maps open, an invalid or empty ?list= (silently shows the visitor's own list), or undo after «ہٹائیں» (reader #20). The copy success text exists (published ui plan.copied). Nothing can be added in Urdu; a string and template change would be needed.

The sources disagree on kind: en 'Location ↗' and ar «الموقع ↗» are a noun, while the approved zh line is an action (在谷歌地图中打开 ↗, 'open in Google Maps') and the de/ru are nouns. The Urdu follows en and ar (N731). If the owner wants the action reading on all languages, the English and Arabic change first.

English noun drift on one page: the title and buttons say 'places', the counter and the shared heading say 'sights' (the ctx example even reads '{n} saved places'); recorded at s1. The Urdu keeps the published pair «سیاحتی مقامات» / «مقامات» per string.
